popCulture.title: Callirhoe (daughter of Achelous)
popCulture.description: Naiad daughter of Achelous, second wife of Alcmaeon — she demands Harmonia's necklace and robe, then prays Zeus for sons who will avenge their father. Not the Oceanid Callirhoe nor the Calydonian spring-nymph of the same name.

popCulture.title: Alcmaeon (mythology)
popCulture.description: Callirhoe's husband after his purification by Achelous — the Epigoni matricide whose second marriage ends in the necklace's deadly demand.

popCulture.title: Alcmaeon in Corinth
popCulture.creator: Euripides
popCulture.description: Euripides' posthumous tragedy of Alcmaeon's children — the Corinthian recognition play that keeps Callirhoe's line in Attic drama.

popCulture.title: Achelous
popCulture.description: Callirhoe's river-god father — the Aetolian stream who purifies Alcmaeon and gives him his daughter.
